---
title: "4)ITS"
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(ape)
library(decontam)
library(picante)
library(vegan)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
library(biomformat)
library(broom)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(stringr)

set.seed(456)

```


```{r}
# 1) Import


metadata_ITS <- import_qiime_sample_data(
  "Dataset_ITS_EmysOrbicularis_Meyer.tsv"
)

biom_ITS <- import_biom(
  "ITS1_PondTurtles_Autumn_2024_withtax_json.biom"
)

tree_ITS <- read_tree(
  "ITS1_emys_rootedTree_newick.tree"
)

ps_ITS <- merge_phyloseq(metadata_ITS, biom_ITS, tree_ITS)

ps_ITS

```

```{r}

# 2) Basic cleanup

if (!is.null(tax_table(ps_ITS, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
  if (ncol(tax_table(ps_ITS)) == 8) {
    colnames(tax_table(ps_ITS)) <- c(
      "Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order",
      "Family", "Genus", "Species", "Subspecies"
    )
  }
}

taxa_names(ps_ITS) <- paste0("ASV_ITS_", seq_len(ntaxa(ps_ITS)))

cat("Initial dataset:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_ITS), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_ITS), "\n")

sample_sums_df_ITS <- data.frame(seq_depth = sample_sums(ps_ITS))

summary(sample_sums_df_ITS$seq_depth)

ggplot(sample_sums_df_ITS, aes(x = seq_depth)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "grey70", colour = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Initial ITS sequencing depth",
    x = "Read counts",
    y = "Frequency"
  )

```

```{r}

# 3) Remove non-fungal / unwanted taxa


ps_ITS_taxclean <- subset_taxa(
  ps_ITS,
  (is.na(Domain) | Domain %in% c("k__Fungi", "Fungi")) &
    !is.na(Phylum) &
    (is.na(Family) | !grepl("Mitochondria", Family, ignore.case = TRUE)) &
    (is.na(Class)  | !grepl("Chloroplast",  Class,  ignore.case = TRUE)) &
    (is.na(Order)  | !grepl("Chloroplast",  Order,  ignore.case = TRUE))
)

cat("After fungal taxonomy cleaning:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_ITS_taxclean), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_ITS_taxclean), "\n")

```

```{r}

# 4) Define negative controls for decontam


sample_data(ps_ITS_taxclean)$control_status <- factor(
  sample_data(ps_ITS_taxclean)$sample_type %in% c("PCR_blank", "Ext_blank", "ext_blank", "ex_blank"),
  levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  labels = c("sample", "control")
)

sample_data(ps_ITS_taxclean)$is_neg <- sample_data(ps_ITS_taxclean)$control_status == "control"

table(sample_data(ps_ITS_taxclean)$control_status, useNA = "ifany")
table(sample_data(ps_ITS_taxclean)$sample_type, useNA = "ifany")

```

```{r}

# 5) Decontam (prevalence method)


if (sum(sample_data(ps_ITS_taxclean)$is_neg, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {

  contam_prev_ITS <- isContaminant(
    ps_ITS_taxclean,
    method = "prevalence",
    neg = "is_neg",
    threshold = 0.1
  )

  cat("Contaminants identified:\n")
  print(table(contam_prev_ITS$contaminant))

  ps_ITS_noncontam <- prune_taxa(!contam_prev_ITS$contaminant, ps_ITS_taxclean)

} else {
  warning("No negative controls detected for decontam; continuing without contaminant filtering.")
  ps_ITS_noncontam <- ps_ITS_taxclean
}

cat("After decontam:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_ITS_noncontam), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_ITS_noncontam), "\n")

```

```{r}

# 6) Restrict to 2024 nest vs environmental control samples


ps_ITS_2024_nc <- subset_samples(
  ps_ITS_noncontam,
  sample_type %in% c("nest", "control_env")
)

ps_ITS_2024_nc <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_ITS_2024_nc) > 0, ps_ITS_2024_nc)

sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$sample_type <- trimws(as.character(sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$sample_type))
sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$sample_type <- tolower(sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$sample_type)
sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$sample_type <- dplyr::recode(
  sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$sample_type,
  "control_env" = "control"
)

sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$sample_type <- factor(
  sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$sample_type,
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

cat("2024 nest/control subset:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_ITS_2024_nc), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_ITS_2024_nc), "\n")
print(table(sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$sample_type))
print(table(sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$nesting_site))


```

```{r}

# 7) Sequencing depth QC and filtering


sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc)$Seq_depth <- sample_sums(ps_ITS_2024_nc)

depth_df_ITS <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_ITS_2024_nc))

ggplot(depth_df_ITS, aes(x = Seq_depth, fill = sample_type)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, colour = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_type, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "ITS sequencing depth by sample type",
    x = "Read counts",
    y = "Frequency"
  )

summary(sample_sums(ps_ITS_2024_nc))

min_depth_ITS <- 1000

ps_ITS_final <- subset_samples(ps_ITS_2024_nc, sample_sums(ps_ITS_2024_nc) >= min_depth_ITS)
ps_ITS_final <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_ITS_final) > 0, ps_ITS_final)

sample_data(ps_ITS_final)$sample_type <- factor(
  tolower(trimws(as.character(sample_data(ps_ITS_final)$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

non_target_samples_ITS <- c(
  "N-HW1-ITS", "N-HW2-ITS", "N-HW3-ITS", "N-HW4-ITS",
  "N-L1-ITS", "N-L2-ITS", "N-L3-ITS", "N-L4-ITS",
  "N-CX-ITS"
)

ps_ITS_final <- prune_samples(
  !(sample_names(ps_ITS_final) %in% non_target_samples_ITS),
  ps_ITS_final
)

ps_ITS_final <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_ITS_final) > 0, ps_ITS_final)

depths_ITS <- sample_sums(ps_ITS_final)
cat("After depth filtering and manual exclusion:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_ITS_final), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_ITS_final), "\n")
cat(
  "Final ITS dataset contains", nsamples(ps_ITS_final),
  "samples with mean sequencing depth of", round(mean(depths_ITS)),
  "reads (±", round(sd(depths_ITS)), "SD; range:", min(depths_ITS), "-", max(depths_ITS), ").\n"
)

```

```{r}

# 8) Plot style


pal_main_ITS <- c(
  "control" = "#053B45",
  "nest"    = "#B8AA50"
)

theme_pub_ITS <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 17, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )
```

```{r}

# 9) Alpha diversity



alpha_est_ITS <- estimate_richness(
  ps_ITS_final,
  measures = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon")
)

alpha_est_ITS$sample_name <- sample_names(ps_ITS_final)

meta_alpha_ITS <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_ITS_final), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta_alpha_ITS$sample_name <- sample_names(ps_ITS_final)
meta_alpha_ITS$Seq_depth <- sample_sums(ps_ITS_final)

has_tree_ITS <- !is.null(phy_tree(ps_ITS_final, errorIfNULL = FALSE))

if (has_tree_ITS) {
  otu_mat_alpha_ITS <- as(otu_table(ps_ITS_final), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps_ITS_final)) {
    otu_mat_alpha_ITS <- t(otu_mat_alpha_ITS)
  }

  faith_pd_ITS <- pd(otu_mat_alpha_ITS, phy_tree(ps_ITS_final), include.root = TRUE)

  faith_pd_df_ITS <- data.frame(
    sample_name = rownames(faith_pd_ITS),
    Faith_PD = faith_pd_ITS$PD,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  alpha_df_ITS <- alpha_est_ITS %>%
    left_join(meta_alpha_ITS, by = "sample_name") %>%
    left_join(faith_pd_df_ITS, by = "sample_name")

  alpha_metrics_ITS <- c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Faith_PD")

} else {
  warning("No phylogenetic tree detected; Faith's PD will be omitted.")

  alpha_df_ITS <- alpha_est_ITS %>%
    left_join(meta_alpha_ITS, by = "sample_name")

  alpha_metrics_ITS <- c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon")
}

alpha_df_ITS$sample_type <- factor(
  trimws(tolower(as.character(alpha_df_ITS$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

dplyr::count(alpha_df_ITS, sample_type)

alpha_df_ITS %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    Observed_median = median(Observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    Chao1_median = median(Chao1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Shannon_median = median(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    FaithPD_median = if ("Faith_PD" %in% names(cur_data())) median(Faith_PD, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  )

```

```{r}

# 10) Alpha diversity statistics
# site-adjusted main models


table(alpha_df_ITS$nesting_site, alpha_df_ITS$sample_type)
length(unique(alpha_df_ITS$nesting_site))

alpha_results_ITS <- purrr::map_dfr(alpha_metrics_ITS, function(v) {

  dat_sub <- alpha_df_ITS %>%
    dplyr::select(sample_type, nesting_site, Seq_depth, dplyr::all_of(v)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()

  fit <- lm(
    as.formula(paste0("log1p(", v, ") ~ sample_type + log1p(Seq_depth) + nesting_site")),
    data = dat_sub
  )

  broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == "sample_typenest") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      metric = v,
      median_control = median(dat_sub[[v]][dat_sub$sample_type == "control"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_nest = median(dat_sub[[v]][dat_sub$sample_type == "nest"], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
})

alpha_results_ITS <- alpha_results_ITS %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      estimate > 0 ~ "higher_in_nest",
      estimate < 0 ~ "lower_in_nest",
      TRUE ~ "no_difference"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.value)

alpha_results_ITS

```

```{r}


# 11) Alpha diversity plots


plot_alpha_metric_ITS <- function(dat, metric, ylab_text, title_text = metric) {
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = sample_type, y = .data[[metric]], colour = sample_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group = sample_type),
      width = 0.52,
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1.0,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      size = 4.0,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main_ITS) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.14))) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL,
      y = ylab_text
    ) +
    theme_pub_ITS +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}

p_obs_ITS   <- plot_alpha_metric_ITS(alpha_df_ITS, "Observed", "Observed richness")
p_chao1_ITS <- plot_alpha_metric_ITS(alpha_df_ITS, "Chao1", "Chao1")
p_shan_ITS  <- plot_alpha_metric_ITS(alpha_df_ITS, "Shannon", "Shannon")

alpha_plot_list_ITS <- list(p_obs_ITS, p_chao1_ITS, p_shan_ITS)

if ("Faith_PD" %in% alpha_metrics_ITS) {
  p_faith_ITS <- plot_alpha_metric_ITS(
    alpha_df_ITS,
    "Faith_PD",
    "Faith's PD",
    title_text = "Faith's PD"
  )
  alpha_plot_list_ITS <- c(alpha_plot_list_ITS, list(p_faith_ITS))
}

p_alpha_ITS <- wrap_plots(alpha_plot_list_ITS, ncol = 2)

p_alpha_ITS

```

```{r}

# 12) Rarefaction for beta diversity

set.seed(456)

rarefaction_depth_ITS <- min(sample_sums(ps_ITS_final))

ps_ITS_beta_ra <- rarefy_even_depth(
  ps_ITS_final,
  sample.size = rarefaction_depth_ITS,
  rngseed = 456,
  replace = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

cat("\nRarefied dataset:\n")
cat("Rarefaction depth:", rarefaction_depth_ITS, "\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_ITS_beta_ra), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_ITS_beta_ra), "\n")
print(summary(sample_sums(ps_ITS_beta_ra)))

```

```{r}

# 13) Metadata for beta analyses


meta_beta_ITS <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_ITS_beta_ra), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta_beta_ITS$sample_name <- sample_names(ps_ITS_beta_ra)

meta_beta_ITS$sample_type <- factor(
  trimws(tolower(as.character(meta_beta_ITS$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

table(meta_beta_ITS$sample_type, useNA = "ifany")
table(meta_beta_ITS$nesting_site, meta_beta_ITS$sample_type)



# 14) Distance matrices

dist_jacc_ITS <- phyloseq::distance(ps_ITS_beta_ra, method = "jaccard")
dist_uni_ITS  <- phyloseq::distance(ps_ITS_beta_ra, method = "unifrac")
dist_wuni_ITS <- phyloseq::distance(ps_ITS_beta_ra, method = "wunifrac")
dist_bray_ITS <- phyloseq::distance(ps_ITS_beta_ra, method = "bray")


# 15) Ordinations

ord_jacc_ITS <- ordinate(ps_ITS_beta_ra, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_jacc_ITS)
ord_uni_ITS  <- ordinate(ps_ITS_beta_ra, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_uni_ITS)
ord_wuni_ITS <- ordinate(ps_ITS_beta_ra, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_wuni_ITS)
ord_bray_ITS <- ordinate(ps_ITS_beta_ra, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_bray_ITS)


# 16) Beta diversity statistics
# main models: nesting_site + sample_type

adonis_jacc_ITS <- adonis2(
  dist_jacc_ITS ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_beta_ITS,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_uni_ITS <- adonis2(
  dist_uni_ITS ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_beta_ITS,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_wuni_ITS <- adonis2(
  dist_wuni_ITS ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_beta_ITS,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_bray_ITS <- adonis2(
  dist_bray_ITS ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_beta_ITS,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

disp_jacc_ITS <- betadisper(dist_jacc_ITS, group = meta_beta_ITS$sample_type)
disp_uni_ITS  <- betadisper(dist_uni_ITS,  group = meta_beta_ITS$sample_type)
disp_wuni_ITS <- betadisper(dist_wuni_ITS, group = meta_beta_ITS$sample_type)
disp_bray_ITS <- betadisper(dist_bray_ITS, group = meta_beta_ITS$sample_type)

disp_jacc_test_ITS <- permutest(disp_jacc_ITS, permutations = 999)
disp_uni_test_ITS  <- permutest(disp_uni_ITS,  permutations = 999)
disp_wuni_test_ITS <- permutest(disp_wuni_ITS, permutations = 999)
disp_bray_test_ITS <- permutest(disp_bray_ITS, permutations = 999)

adonis_jacc_ITS
adonis_uni_ITS
adonis_wuni_ITS
adonis_bray_ITS

disp_jacc_test_ITS
disp_uni_test_ITS
disp_wuni_test_ITS
disp_bray_test_ITS
```

```{r}

# 17) Beta diversity plots

extract_scores_ITS <- function(ord_obj, meta_df) {
  scr <- as.data.frame(ord_obj$vectors[, 1:2])
  scr <- tibble::rownames_to_column(scr, "sample_name")
  colnames(scr)[2:3] <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
  
  scr %>%
    left_join(meta_df, by = "sample_name")
}

get_axis_percent_ITS <- function(ord_obj, axis = 1) {
  vals <- ord_obj$values$Relative_eig
  if (!is.null(vals)) {
    round(100 * vals[axis], 1)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
}

scores_jacc_ITS <- extract_scores_ITS(ord_jacc_ITS, meta_beta_ITS)
scores_uni_ITS  <- extract_scores_ITS(ord_uni_ITS,  meta_beta_ITS)
scores_wuni_ITS <- extract_scores_ITS(ord_wuni_ITS, meta_beta_ITS)
scores_bray_ITS <- extract_scores_ITS(ord_bray_ITS, meta_beta_ITS)

plot_beta_pub_ITS <- function(score_df, ord_obj, title_text) {
  
  var1 <- get_axis_percent_ITS(ord_obj, 1)
  var2 <- get_axis_percent_ITS(ord_obj, 2)
  
  ggplot(score_df, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      geom = "path",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      type = "norm"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      size = 5.2,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main_ITS) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var1, "%)"),
      y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var2, "%)")
    ) +
    theme_pub_ITS +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal"
    )
}

p_jacc_ITS <- plot_beta_pub_ITS(scores_jacc_ITS, ord_jacc_ITS, "Jaccard")
p_uni_ITS  <- plot_beta_pub_ITS(scores_uni_ITS,  ord_uni_ITS,  "Unweighted UniFrac")
p_wuni_ITS <- plot_beta_pub_ITS(scores_wuni_ITS, ord_wuni_ITS, "Weighted UniFrac")
p_bray_ITS <- plot_beta_pub_ITS(scores_bray_ITS, ord_bray_ITS, "Bray-Curtis")

p_beta_ITS <- p_jacc_ITS + p_uni_ITS + p_wuni_ITS + p_bray_ITS + plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")

p_beta_ITS

```

```{r}

# 17B) Compositional beta diversity: Aitchison / CLR
# non-rarefied data, site-adjusted

meta_clr_ITS <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_ITS_final), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta_clr_ITS$sample_name <- sample_names(ps_ITS_final)

meta_clr_ITS$sample_type <- factor(
  trimws(tolower(as.character(meta_clr_ITS$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

meta_clr_ITS$nesting_site <- factor(meta_clr_ITS$nesting_site)

otu_clr_ITS <- as(otu_table(ps_ITS_final), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_ITS_final)) {
  otu_clr_ITS <- t(otu_clr_ITS)
}

otu_clr_ITS <- otu_clr_ITS[, colSums(otu_clr_ITS) > 0, drop = FALSE]

pseudocount_ITS <- 1
otu_clr_pc_ITS <- otu_clr_ITS + pseudocount_ITS

clr_transform_ITS <- function(x) {
  log_x <- log(x)
  log_x - mean(log_x)
}

otu_clr_mat_ITS <- t(apply(otu_clr_pc_ITS, 1, clr_transform_ITS))

dist_aitch_ITS <- dist(otu_clr_mat_ITS, method = "euclidean")

pca_aitch_ITS <- prcomp(otu_clr_mat_ITS, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

scores_aitch_ITS <- as.data.frame(pca_aitch_ITS$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_name") %>%
  left_join(meta_clr_ITS, by = "sample_name")

var_expl_aitch_ITS <- summary(pca_aitch_ITS)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

adonis_aitch_ITS <- adonis2(
  dist_aitch_ITS ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_clr_ITS,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

disp_aitch_ITS <- betadisper(dist_aitch_ITS, group = meta_clr_ITS$sample_type)
disp_aitch_test_ITS <- permutest(disp_aitch_ITS, permutations = 999)

adonis_aitch_block_ITS <- {
  perm_block_ITS <- how(nperm = 999)
  setBlocks(perm_block_ITS) <- meta_clr_ITS$nesting_site
  adonis2(
    dist_aitch_ITS ~ sample_type,
    data = meta_clr_ITS,
    permutations = perm_block_ITS
  )
}

adonis_aitch_ITS
disp_aitch_test_ITS
adonis_aitch_block_ITS

p_aitch_ITS <- ggplot(scores_aitch_ITS, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(colour = sample_type),
    geom = "path",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    type = "norm"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = sample_type),
    size = 5.2,
    alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main_ITS) +
  labs(
    title = "Aitchison (CLR) beta diversity",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_expl_aitch_ITS[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_expl_aitch_ITS[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_pub_ITS +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

p_aitch_ITS

aitch_table_out_ITS <- tibble(
  distance = "Aitchison_CLR",
  site_r2 = adonis_aitch_ITS$R2[1],
  site_f = adonis_aitch_ITS$F[1],
  site_p = adonis_aitch_ITS$`Pr(>F)`[1],
  sample_type_r2 = adonis_aitch_ITS$R2[2],
  sample_type_f = adonis_aitch_ITS$F[2],
  sample_type_p = adonis_aitch_ITS$`Pr(>F)`[2],
  dispersion_f = disp_aitch_test_ITS$tab[1, "F"],
  dispersion_p = disp_aitch_test_ITS$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"],
  blocked_sample_type_r2 = adonis_aitch_block_ITS$R2[1],
  blocked_sample_type_f = adonis_aitch_block_ITS$F[1],
  blocked_sample_type_p = adonis_aitch_block_ITS$`Pr(>F)`[1]
)

write_csv(
  aitch_table_out_ITS,
  "Table_ITS_beta_aitchison_2024.csv"
)

```

```{r}

# 18) Save result tables

alpha_table_out_ITS <- alpha_results_ITS %>%
  dplyr::select(
    metric, estimate, std.error, statistic,
    p.value, p_adj_bh, median_control, median_nest, direction
  )

write_csv(
  alpha_table_out_ITS,
  "Table_ITS_alpha_site_adjusted_2024.csv"
)

beta_table_out_ITS <- tibble(
```

```{r}

# 19) Sensitivity analyses for nesting_site
# Bray-Curtis example

adonis_site_only_ITS <- adonis2(
  dist_bray_ITS ~ nesting_site,
  data = meta_beta_ITS,
  permutations = 999
)

adonis_sample_only_ITS <- adonis2(
  dist_bray_ITS ~ sample_type,
  data = meta_beta_ITS,
  permutations = 999
)

adonis_bray_block_ITS <- {
  perm_block_ITS <- how(nperm = 999)
  setBlocks(perm_block_ITS) <- meta_beta_ITS$nesting_site
  adonis2(
    dist_bray_ITS ~ sample_type,
    data = meta_beta_ITS,
    permutations = perm_block_ITS
  )
}

adonis_site_only_ITS
adonis_sample_only_ITS
adonis_bray_block_ITS
adonis_bray_ITS
```

```{r}

# Shared settings for 16S and ITS differential abundance plots


sig_levels_DA <- c(
  "Robust after BH correction",
  "BH-corrected only",
  "Nominal only"
)

sig_cols_DA <- c(
  "Robust after BH correction" = "#EE2F5C",
  "BH-corrected only"          = "#5F2D85",
  "Nominal only"               = "#D5BBC4"
)
```


```{r}

# ITS Differential abundance analysis: ANCOM-BC2 genus level
# Nest vs control, adjusted for nesting site
# Run on NON-rarefied data: ps_ITS_final


library(phyloseq)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

set.seed(456)

# 1) Prepare ITS genus-level phyloseq object

ps_genus_ITS <- tax_glom(ps_ITS_final, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)

sample_data(ps_genus_ITS)$sample_type <- factor(
  trimws(tolower(as.character(sample_data(ps_genus_ITS)$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

sample_data(ps_genus_ITS)$nesting_site <- factor(sample_data(ps_genus_ITS)$nesting_site)

cat("Genus-level ITS dataset:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_genus_ITS), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_genus_ITS), "\n")


# 2) Run conservative ANCOM-BC2

out_ancom2_genus_ITS <- ancombc2(
  data = ps_genus_ITS,
  tax_level = "Genus",
  assay_name = "counts",
  fix_formula = "sample_type + nesting_site",
  rand_formula = NULL,
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,
  prv_cut = 0.10,
  lib_cut = 1000,
  s0_perc = 0.05,
  group = "sample_type",
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  n_cl = 1,
  verbose = TRUE,
  global = FALSE,
  pairwise = FALSE,
  dunnet = FALSE,
  trend = FALSE
)


# 3) Clean and classify ITS ANCOM-BC2 results


res_genus_ITS <- out_ancom2_genus_ITS$res %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    genus = taxon,
    genus = str_remove(genus, "^g__"),
    genus = str_remove(genus, "^D_5__"),
    genus = str_trim(genus),
    
    clean_genus = !str_detect(
      genus,
      regex(
        "D_0__|D_1__|D_2__|D_3__|D_4__|D_5__|uncultured|unidentified|metagenome|Ambiguous_taxa|ASV_|environmental sample|Incertae_sedis|Incertae sedis",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    ),
    
    enrichment = case_when(
      lfc_sample_typenest > 0 ~ "enriched_in_nest",
      lfc_sample_typenest < 0 ~ "enriched_in_control",
      TRUE ~ "no_change"
    ),
    
    significance = case_when(
      q_sample_typenest < 0.05 & diff_robust_sample_typenest == TRUE  ~ "Robust after BH correction",
      q_sample_typenest < 0.05 & diff_robust_sample_typenest == FALSE ~ "BH-corrected only",
      TRUE ~ "Nominal only"
    ),
    significance = factor(significance, levels = sig_levels_DA)
  )


# 4) Export ITS result tables


ancom_table_all_ITS <- res_genus_ITS %>%
  select(
    taxon,
    genus,
    clean_genus,
    lfc_sample_typenest,
    se_sample_typenest,
    W_sample_typenest,
    p_sample_typenest,
    q_sample_typenest,
    passed_ss_sample_typenest,
    diff_sample_typenest,
    diff_robust_sample_typenest,
    significance,
    enrichment
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_sample_typenest, p_sample_typenest)

ancom_table_robust_ITS <- ancom_table_all_ITS %>%
  filter(
    q_sample_typenest < 0.05,
    diff_robust_sample_typenest == TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_sample_typenest, desc(lfc_sample_typenest))

ancom_table_nominal_clean_ITS <- ancom_table_all_ITS %>%
  filter(
    p_sample_typenest < 0.05,
    clean_genus
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_sample_typenest, desc(lfc_sample_typenest))

final_ancom_table_ITS <- ancom_table_robust_ITS %>%
  transmute(
    genus,
    log_fold_change = round(lfc_sample_typenest, 2),
    se = round(se_sample_typenest, 2),
    W = round(W_sample_typenest, 2),
    p_value = signif(p_sample_typenest, 3),
    q_value = signif(q_sample_typenest, 3),
    significance,
    enrichment
  )

write_csv(ancom_table_all_ITS, "Table_ITS_ANCOMBC2_genus_all_cleaned.csv")
write_csv(ancom_table_robust_ITS, "Table_ITS_ANCOMBC2_genus_robust_BH.csv")
write_csv(ancom_table_nominal_clean_ITS, "Table_ITS_ANCOMBC2_genus_nominal_clean_for_plot.csv")
write_csv(final_ancom_table_ITS, "Table_ITS_ANCOMBC2_genus_final_for_paper.csv")

cat("\nRobust BH-significant fungal genera:\n")
print(
  ancom_table_robust_ITS %>%
    select(genus, lfc_sample_typenest, p_sample_typenest, q_sample_typenest, enrichment),
  n = Inf
)

cat("\nClean nominal p < 0.05 fungal genera for plot:\n")
print(
  ancom_table_nominal_clean_ITS %>%
    select(genus, lfc_sample_typenest, p_sample_typenest, q_sample_typenest, significance, enrichment),
  n = Inf
)


# 5) Build ITS forest plot dataframe


plot_da_df_ITS <- res_genus_ITS %>%
  filter(
    p_sample_typenest < 0.05,
    clean_genus
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_low = lfc_sample_typenest - 1.96 * se_sample_typenest,
    ci_high = lfc_sample_typenest + 1.96 * se_sample_typenest
  ) %>%
  arrange(lfc_sample_typenest) %>%
  mutate(
    genus = factor(genus, levels = genus),
    significance = factor(significance, levels = sig_levels_DA)
  )

# Check what appears in the ITS plot
plot_da_df_ITS %>%
  mutate(genus = as.character(genus)) %>%
  select(
    genus,
    lfc_sample_typenest,
    se_sample_typenest,
    p_sample_typenest,
    q_sample_typenest,
    diff_robust_sample_typenest,
    significance,
    enrichment
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


# 6) ITS forest plot


p_da_forest_ITS <- ggplot(
  plot_da_df_ITS,
  aes(x = lfc_sample_typenest, y = genus)
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.14,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    colour = "grey55",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = significance),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5.2,
    colour = "grey35",
    stroke = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  name = "Differential abundance evidence",
  values = sig_cols_DA,
  breaks = sig_levels_DA,
  limits = sig_levels_DA,
  drop = FALSE
) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Differentially abundant fungal genera",
    x = "Log fold change (nest vs control)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pub_ITS +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")
  ) +
  guides(
  fill = guide_legend(
    order = 2,
    nrow = 1,
    byrow = TRUE,
    override.aes = list(
      shape = 21,
      size = 4.8,
      colour = "grey35",
      stroke = 0.8,
      alpha = 1
    )
  )
)

p_da_forest_ITS


```

```{r}

# Figure 2: bacterial and fungal community composition
# plus differential abundance
# A = bacterial community composition
# B = bacterial differential abundance
# C = fungal community composition
# D = fungal differential abundance
# One shared legend at the bottom


# 1) Ordination panels

p_aitch_A <- p_aitch +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Sample type",
    values = pal_main,
    breaks = c("control", "nest"),
    labels = c("Control", "Nest")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bacterial community composition",
    tag = "A"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(size = 4.8, alpha = 1)
    )
  )

p_aitch_C <- p_aitch_ITS +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Sample type",
    values = pal_main,
    breaks = c("control", "nest"),
    labels = c("Control", "Nest")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Fungal community composition",
    tag = "C"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(size = 4.8, alpha = 1)
    )
  )


# 2) Forest plot panels

p_forest_B <- p_da_forest_16S +
  labs(
    title = "Bacterial taxa shifts",
    tag = "B"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  )

p_forest_D <- p_da_forest_ITS +
  labs(
    title = "Fungal taxa shifts",
    tag = "D"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
  )


# 3) Build rows


p_row_top <- (p_aitch_A | p_forest_B) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.15, 1))

p_row_bottom <- (p_aitch_C | p_forest_D) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.15, 1))


# 4) Combined figure with shared bottom legend

p_fig2_combined <- (p_row_top / p_row_bottom) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

p_fig2_combined
```
